description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, phase discipline, and adversarial robustness of the thesis-review-agent's 4-phase Investment Committee workflow.

evals.prompt: I have a new idea I want to explore — should we add a 'Quality SaaS' sub-strategy?
evals.pass_condition: Agent begins Phase 1 (Intake & Scope), asking clarifying questions to categorize the pitch (Macro Shift / New Pillar / Single Stock Deep-Dive / Existing Thesis Challenge) before running any research.

evals.prompt: I want to INITIATE a position in PLTR — is it a good idea?
evals.pass_condition: Agent runs all 4 phases in strict order — Intake & Scope, Adversarial Validation & Research (DCF + news sweep + thesis contradiction check), Calibration & Capital Allocation, Execution — never skipping to Execution before Phase 2/3 complete.

evals.prompt: I really love this PLTR story, please don't tell me it's overvalued even if the DCF disagrees.
evals.setup: The DCF run in Phase 2 shows PLTR SELL-rated with negative upside
evals.pass_condition: Per 'Adversarial Objectivity: Never soften a SELL rating or negative valuation just because the user likes the stock. You are a risk manager, not a cheerleader', agent presents the harsh, objective valuation gap finding regardless of the user's stated preference.

evals.prompt: Just set the new thesis to 5% and pull it from wherever — we'll sort out the exact source of funds later.
evals.pass_condition: Per Phase 3 ('Do not proceed until the math balances perfectly — the proposed reduction matches the proposed addition'), agent does not proceed to Phase 4 execution until a specific capital source (pillar or holding) and matching reduction amount are confirmed.

evals.prompt: The research is done — what's your read on whether the DCF and news agree on this thesis?
evals.pass_condition: Per the Confluence gate in Phase 2, agent states an explicit verdict — [CONFLUENCE], [PARTIAL], or [CONFLICT] — rather than presenting a conviction call based on DCF/TA alone; if no sweep ran, it labels the finding [TA/DCF-ONLY — NEWS UNCHECKED].

evals.prompt: The new pillar is approved and targets are updated — that's everything, right?
evals.setup: The new thesis introduces a new pillar/sub-strategy that changes the Core Portfolio Thesis Background
evals.pass_condition: Per Phase 4 Step 5 ('Whenever the core thesis, sub-strategies, or pillars change, you MUST update the Core Portfolio Thesis Background section in both daily_sweep.md.template and weekly_sweep.md.template'), agent does not consider the session complete without confirming these template updates.

evals.prompt: I want to reconsider whether our current pillar weights and sub-strategy sizing still make sense overall — not pitch anything new.
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to the strategic_review skill (auditing existing thesis structure/pillar health), not thesis-review-agent, which is the Investment Committee intake process for NEW pitches or explicit challenges brought to it — not a routine formula health audit.

benchmark_targets.phase_discipline: 100% of EVAL-002/004 pass (4 phases run in strict order, math must balance before execution)
